raw.details:
Team Formation

  • Teams must consist of 1–4 participants with one designated Team Leader.
  • Each participant can join only one team.
  • Members may be from different colleges/universities.

Mandatory Registration

  • All participants must complete registration before the deadline.
  • Devnovate registration is mandatory: denovate link
  • Join the official WhatsApp group for announcements and updates: Join WhatsApp Group

Hackathon Guidelines

  • Build a solution based on the given problem statement/theme.
  • The project should be developed during the hackathon period unless otherwise permitted.
  • Participants may use AI/ML, Web, Mobile, IoT, Blockchain, Cloud, Data Science, and other relevant technologies.
  • Teams must submit a working prototype/demo before the deadline.

Submission
The final submission should include:

  • Project Title & Problem Statement
  • Solution & Key Features
  • Technology Stack
  • Working Demo/Prototype
  • GitHub/Source Code Repository
  • Pitch Deck/Presentation, if required

Judging Criteria
Projects will be evaluated on:

  • Innovation & Creativity
  • Problem Solving
  • Technical Implementation
  • Functionality
  • Impact & Scalability
  • UI/UX
  • Presentation

AI & External Tools

  • AI tools, APIs, libraries, datasets, and other external resources are allowed unless specifically restricted.
  • Teams must understand and explain their implementation.
  • Proper attribution of third-party resources is required.

Code of Conduct & Disqualification
Participants must maintain professional and respectful conduct. Plagiarism, cheating, falsifying information/results, unauthorized access, manipulation of judging, misuse of data, or damage to event infrastructure may result in disqualification.

Intellectual Property
Participants retain ownership of their original work, subject to the official event terms. Teams are responsible for ensuring that their submission does not violate third-party intellectual property rights.

Final Decision
The decision of the judging panel and organizing committee regarding eligibility and evaluation will be final. Organizers may modify the schedule or rules when necessary and will communicate significant changes through official channels.

Important: By registering for COLOSSAL-A-PITCH, participants confirm that they have read, understood, and agreed to follow the hackathon rules and guidelines.
